verdict:
REJECT / FLAT — and the discount is JUSTIFIED, not a discount to harvest. Blue PARTIALLY OVERTURNED red (8/10): two of red's three FATAL legs are base-effect artifacts and a third is backwards.

THE DECISIVE FINDING, and it dissolves the premise this name was courted on: A 7.3% POST-FEE ROE MAKES 0.70x NAV A FAIR PRICE. Blue's line is the one to remember — 'mark integrity is real and IRRELEVANT AT A JUSTIFIED P/B.' We came to OTF because it carried the deepest discount in the Blue Owl pair (32.5%); the answer is that a book earning 7.3% after fees SHOULD trade near 0.7x. There is nothing to harvest.

WHAT SURVIVES ON CONFIRMED EVIDENCE: post-listing run-rate NII of $0.30 against a $1.40 base; a fee step that is COMPLETED, not continuing; ~$475M of 6.50% debt raised to fund DISTRIBUTIONS AND BUYBACKS; asset coverage down 23 points in two quarters.

WHAT DIED, and it is a lesson about our own reading: red's headline was an 18.7% NII collapse ($0.369 -> $0.301). That is the CAPITAL-GAINS INCENTIVE FEE swinging sign — Q1 accrued NEGATIVE $10,685k, Q2 accrued +$29,316k, on a flat $53.9M management fee. Normalised for the ~$39M reversal the series is $0.285 -> $0.301, i.e. RISING 5.6%. Management's own 'Adjusted NII' made exactly this adjustment and both benches initially graded it as venue-divergent MASKING. It was the honest number. Harvested as a detector.

MY THESIS DID NOT SURVIVE EITHER: I framed the same-adviser pair expecting the 13-point discount spread to expose mark posture. It exposed ROE.
reopen_gates: NONE. Re-court only on TWO CONSECUTIVE QUARTERS of clean NII >=$0.33 WITH asset coverage stable >=210%, or a base cut to a covered level that re-rates ROE above the fee load. The 2026-11-04 print is a WATCH, not a trigger. Note: at a 7.3% post-fee ROE, 0.70x NAV is fair — a wider discount is not automatically an entry.
adjudicator_note: Same-adviser natural experiment (OTF vs OBDC, identical fee template). It did NOT expose mark posture as I predicted — marks were identical to the basis point across 115 shared tranches. It exposed ROE (OTF) and a fee/valuation-designee conflict (OBDC). The coverage-count leg of OBDC's kill is VOID under §DIVERGENCE-NOT-COVERAGE; the integrity stack carries it alone.
